Recomputing det(tI−B) reproduces the displayed cubic. For L²=a²+s²+d², the exact evaluation p(L)=d²(2a−1−L) is nonpositive: it is immediate for a≤1/2 and follows for a≥1/2 from L²−(2a−1)²=((11a−3)(1−a)+4d²)/4≥0. Therefore largest eigenvalue ≥L and square ≥x1²+2x2²+2x3²; the weighted completion-of-squares gives unique 1/5 minimum. Equality requires d=0, and its converse follows from the 2×2 block. Principal-submatrix interlacing gives λ3≤−sqrt(a²+s²)≤−1/sqrt5; equality forces uniform weights. The geometric numerator conditions produce c_g=0, a_g/b_g=golden ratio, the icosahedron. Symbolic polynomial identities were independently recomputed; rational-grid verifier is auxiliary, not infinite proof. The bound does not concern collapsed smaller orbits.
